scope.subject: Example workshop storefront and support site (synthetic)
limitations: Training example. All target, code, owner and observation details are fictional. Legal verification dates illustrate the format.
Public routes and a sample repository were reviewed. No forms were submitted, checkout was blocked, and production configuration and operational records were outside scope.

coverage.name: Custom storefront support form
coverage.notes: Reviewed visible fields and the sampled handler.

coverage.name: Shopify checkout
coverage.notes: A cart tied to an authorized test session was unavailable.

evidence.observation: The support form marks phone and email as mandatory. The adjacent text explains the use of email only.
The sampled handler rejects a missing phone value and writes it to a support ticket. Deployed behavior was not established.
The owner says support uses the contact details to respond to enquiries.

observed_facts: The form requires phone and email.
The sampled code writes the phone field to a ticket.

owner_claims.claimed_ground: The owner proposes DPDP Act section 7(a) and has not confirmed its application.

unknowns: Whether support needs a phone number to respond
Retention duration and actual deletion behavior

legal_ledger.notes: Rule 3 is in the eighteen-month phase for notices associated with consent. Confirm the exact commencement day and account for corrigenda. This fixture makes no finding on current-law applicability.

findings.title: Purpose of required phone collection is unclear in the sampled form
findings.observation: The contact form required a phone number without a nearby explanation for that field.
findings.applicability_reason: The processing ground for the contact form is unverified.

findings.title: Ticket deletion remains unverified
findings.observation: The sampled handler does not establish how stored tickets are eventually deleted.
findings.applicability_reason: Retention criteria and the actual processing purpose require internal confirmation.

actions.summary: Confirm why support needs the phone field and amend the form accordingly
actions.target: Custom storefront contact form and its handler at support/contact.py
actions.effort: Small form and validation change if no downstream workflow requires a phone number.
acceptance_criteria: The rendered form makes phone optional unless a documented support workflow requires it.
The rendered form explains the purpose of any retained phone collection.
verification_steps: Load the approved rendered contact form without submitting it. Inspect the phone field, required indicator and adjacent notice.

actions.summary: Request the retention policy and a redacted non-production ticket deletion record
actions.target: Support ticket retention policy and synthetic deletion evidence in the ticketing system
actions.effort: Unknown pending access to the retention schedule and deletion records.
acceptance_criteria: The policy describes a period, trigger, owner and applicable holds.
A redacted verification record traces a synthetic ticket through the applicable deletion steps.
verification_steps: Review the policy and compare a redacted verification record against its deletion triggers and holds.
